create_QianfanOCRProcessor: create a QianfanOCRProcessor instance with image_processor and tokenizer for OCR text-image processing
call_QianfanOCRProcessor: call the QianfanOCRProcessor to process images and interleaved text with image placeholders into tokenized input
insert_media_placeholders: insert media placeholders by replacing <image> tokens with image token sequences in interleaved text prompts
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes including BOI, EOI, and sequence tokens
get_model_input_names: get the combined model input names from tokenizer and image_processor for QianfanOCRProcessor
